description: Baseline capability for every window Studio opens. `windows.rs` names them all `window-…` - the launcher included - for exactly this reason: a label outside the pattern opens a window that can call no command at all. Nothing is declared in `tauri.conf.json` any more, so there is no `main` (S7.7). Permissions are added per feature, not up front. `dialog:allow-open` is what A1's file picker needs; `core:window:allow-set-title` lets the window name the container it holds; `dialog:allow-save` is where a pipeline, a style or a problem report is written to (C9, S6.8); `updater:default` and `process:allow-restart` are G4's check-and-install, which is one action in two halves; `opener:allow-open-url` is scoped to the repository - the alpha ribbon links to it and the problems panel opens an issue on it (S6.8) - and to nothing else.
